about: Parameter counts of the leaderboard's models (Ümit #3465), only as each model's maker documents them: the maker's model card, its Hugging Face repository (card text, config.json, or the safetensors total Hugging Face shows for the maker's own repo, used only where the maker states no figure in text) or its official announcement/docs; the maker's stated figure is used where it and the repository total differ (both in note). total_b, active_b (a mixture of experts; moe true) and effective_b in billions of parameters as shown (an exact repository total rounded to two decimals, the exact count in quote); total_b null = the maker discloses no count (the URLs checked in checked). Never an estimate, a figure from the model's name, its base model or a third party. Read 2026-11-09.

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.quote: a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters ... activate only **8B parameters per token during prefill** and **16B during decode**
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.note: Card table: '# Backbone Params 552B', '# Activated Params 8B / 16B' (prefill/decode); active recorded as the 16B decode figure. Card also lists 'Engram conditional memory (196B parameters, sparsely accessed)' separately from the 552B backbone; total kept at the card's stated 552B. HF safetensors total 763,205,315,794 is not used: it counts packed FP4 experts stored as I8 (557.2B I8 elements), not parameters.

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017.quote: Card states only: 'DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash'; no parameter count on the 1017 card.
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017.note: Not filled from the V4.1-Flash card (lineage). HF safetensors total 763,205,315,794 is identical to V4.1-Flash's and inflated by packed FP4 (I8) storage, so not a parameter count. If Main accepts 'minor update' as same architecture, V4.1-Flash's 552B / 8B-16B applies.
